about_the_game:
Z Ops: Deadzone

Dive into a post-apocalyptic world where humanity is fighting for survival.
In Z Ops: Deadzone, a brutal survival FPS, you play as a member of Z Ops — a global organization formed to stop the spread of Bane-Z, a mysterious Earth-born parasite that infects the human brain. Once infected, hosts become ruthless, aggressive zombies, and only precise headshots can stop them.

The plague spread rapidly, plunging the world into chaos. Civilization collapsed, but Z Ops keeps fighting to protect what remains of humanity and restore some form of order.

As a special forces operative, you will carry out extraction missions, infiltrate infested zones, and participate in raids to recover vital resources.

Warning:
The game is currently in very early access. Some features are still in development and may not reflect the final content of the game. Your experience may vary, and regular updates are planned to improve and enrich the gameplay.

Available Weapons:

  • ZAR-1 (Assault Rifle): A powerful assault rifle designed for close to medium-range combat.

  • P9 (Pistol): A reliable sidearm, perfect for quick defense.

  • Baseball Bat: A melee weapon for close encounters with zombies.

Map:

  • Volygrad (raid section): Explore a portion of the first raid, Volygrad, where you’ll face waves of zombies. This section lets you discover the basic gameplay mechanics and prepares you for more dangerous encounters in future raids.

Colony:
Colony Features:
A version of the colony is accessible, offering a preview of resource management systems. Test the following interactions:

  • Side quests: Take on additional challenges to collect resources or unlock new areas.

  • Shop: Buy essential supplies for your survival.

  • Locker: Manage your gear and resources before heading out on a raid.

  • Raid launch: Start a raid mission and face the dangers of zones infested with Bane-Z.

Bane-Z (Zombies):
Types of Zombies:
The zombies in Z Ops: Deadzone are divided into two types, each with distinct behaviors:

  • Fast zombies: These creatures are agile and aggressive, requiring quick reflexes to dodge and eliminate.

  • Slow zombies: While slower, they are more resistant and require more powerful shots to be taken down.

Gameplay System:

  • Endurance and health: Manage your endurance and health to survive. Use healing items and strategically manage your energy during raids and combat.

  • Loot and trade: Collect items during raids and trade them to improve your gear or buy essential resources.

Upcoming Features:

  • New weapons and equipment to discover.

  • Development of main missions and side quests.

  • Advanced customization system.

  • New areas to explore and new types of zombies.

  • Visual and mechanical improvements based on your feedback.

Join the Resistance!
In Z Ops: Deadzone, humanity is on the brink, and you are its last hope. Survive zombie attacks, explore dangerous zones, manage your resources, and decide humanity’s future.

Developed with Unreal® Engine.
Unreal® is a registered trademark or trademark of Epic Games, Inc. in the U.S. and elsewhere.

content_descriptors.notes: Z Ops: Deadzone includes scenes of intense violence and gore. Players will witness zombies devouring humans, blood splatter, and other graphic depictions of severe injuries, such as throat wounds. The game also features survival themes in a post-apocalyptic setting with moments of extreme tension. There is no sexual content or references to sexual assault, drug or alcohol abuse, or self-harm in this game.

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bits
  • Processor: Intel i5-2500 @2,7 Ghz / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 2 Go / AMD Radeon HD 7870
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatible with DirectX

  • OS: Windows 10 64-bits
  • Processor: Intel i5 4570 @ 3,2 Ghz / AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 4 Go / AMD Radeon R9 380
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatible with DirectX
